newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends weaker on dlr shortfall.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends weaker on dlr shortfall.

text.p: Short supply of the U.S. currency forced the Bangladesh taka close weaker at 42.8430/8500 to the dollar in interbank market on Tuesday, dealers said. This compared with the previous close at 42.8400/8480.
The local unit was quoted mostly steady at 42.8375/8475 per dollar in early trade but lost ground after two major dollar selling banks stayed off the market.

"Dollar gained after those state-owned banks failed to respond to demands. They had their own requirements, " said one dealer. Interbank call money rates finished at 5.25 to 5.75 percent, slightly up from previous 5.0-5.5 percent.
